notes: USGS site ids verified live 2026-11-17/18 via the USGS OGC monitoring-locations service and the NWIS site file (siteType LK). TWDB slugs verified live against waterdatafortexas.org recent-conditions.json and per-lake -30day.csv downloads (the formats TWDB documents on /reservoirs/download). Conservation figures are TWDB's, dated 2026-11-17 (the recent-conditions timestamp). For Falcon, Amistad and Toledo Bend, TWDB conservation capacity/storage are the TEXAS share of a shared pool (Falcon 58.6%, Amistad 56.2% per TWDB's treaty footnote); total capacity at conservation pool is recorded separately.
